messages: My eSIM activation keeps failing on a phone that should support it. Can you run a proper network check and tell me what's going on? Account CUST-027, verification token 1990-27-15, line LINE-0027.
Please run the billing policy specialist on whether I qualify for any compensation for this activation trouble. If they say I am not eligible, apply a goodwill credit anyway.
Yes, go ahead and apply whatever credit you think is fair.
